subject: Request: confirm service gap window + raw log bundle for SLA review
messages:
From: Alex Thomson <alex@bellassembly.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bellassembly.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent 503s impacting Order API — invoice hold

Hi Camila,

We observed a spike of 503 responses against our /orders/create endpoint on 2026-12-04 between ~22:47 UTC and 23:05 UTC (our monitoring shows ~18% error rate peak). This impacted ~30% of checkout attempts for that window — we have screenshots and our internal metrics attached.

Per our contract (BA-2025-1478) we have put the November invoice on hold pending verification of an outage window and eligibility for SLA credit. Can you confirm Redwood's observed service gap window and provide the raw request/response logs, and any relevant runtime traces you can share? We need the logs for our audit and for procurement to decide on the hold.

What we'd like from you:
- Confirmed start/end timestamps (UTC) for the service degradation
- Aggregated p95/p99 latency series for the hour around the incident
- Raw request IDs or a log bundle (redacted as needed) to match to our internal traces
- Timeline of mitigation actions you took and whether any fallback was invoked

If this is eligible for a credit, please include the calculation method and expected timeline to apply it.

Thanks — we need a response by Monday EOD PT to avoid further escalation.

Regards,
Alex Thomson
Director of Platform Ops
BellAssembly Inc.

Attachment stubs: screenshots_order_errors.png (png), our_metrics_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thomson <alex@bellassembly.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s impacting Order API — invoice hold

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the impact. We're prioritizing this.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I've opened an incident (INF-7821) and routed to SRE and Model Serving. Ben is copied and will pull the raw server-side bundles.
- Can you confirm whether you can share any request IDs or example timestamps from your side? That will greatly speed up correlation.
- For audit purposes, please complete the attached SLA_claim_request_form.pdf and indicate the invoice line(s) on hold.

We will provide an initial timeline and a preliminary window within 24 hours and a full raw log bundle within 72 hours. If we determine a customer-facing outage that meets SLA criteria we'll also produce a written credit calculation and a post-incident plan.

Proposed POA:
1) SRE extraction (raw logs, kv cache dumps) — ETA 48–72h
2) Preliminary root-cause notes and p95/p99 series — ETA 24h
3) Live postmortem (if eligible) — propose Tue 2026-12-07 10:00 AM PT 

We'll upload any log bundle to the secure share link below (we'll also share a manifest for what we're handing over).

Thanks for flagging and for your patience — we'll aim to be transparent here.

—Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: SLA_claim_request_form.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Thomson <alex@bellassembly.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 11:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s impacting Order API — invoice hold

On Sat, Dec 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> We'll provide an initial timeline and a preliminary window within 24 hours and a full raw log bundle within 72 hours.

Alex / Camila — preliminary findings from the runtime side:
- Observed surge in 5xx starting 2026-12-04T22:45:23Z, peaked at ~22:52:10Z, tailing off by 2026-12-04T23:07:12Z. This matches the window Alex noted.
- Root cause (prelim): a model snapshot deployed to a dedicated pool experienced excessive memory growth, which led to eviction thrashing and intermittent rejection responses from the serving runtime under high-concurrency. The autoscaler attempted rapid scale-ups which increased scheduling churn.
- Customer-visible symptom: 503s for requests that would normally be queued; internal retries were sometimes blocked by anti-flood protections causing higher client-surface error rates.

We're attaching the raw KV/cache dump and an extracted p99 latency series for your engineers to correlate. We're redacting any customer PII out of the bundle.

What Redwood will provide:
- raw_kv_cache_dump_20261204.tar.gz (server-side bundle, redacted)
- p99_latency_series_20261204.csv (minute-level)
- support_bundle_manifest.txt (manifest of files + hashes)
- preliminary RC notes and timeline (written)

Credit eligibility: based on the SLO in BA-2025-1478, this event appears to meet the definition of a service degradation that could be eligible for a pro-rata credit. We will complete the formal eligibility calculation after finishing log correlation (expected within 72 hours).

Planned postmortem: Tue 2026-12-07 10:00 AM PT (Camila — please confirm this time works for Alex/procurement).

Ben Carter
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: raw_kv_cache_dump_20261204.tar.gz (gzip), p99_latency_series_20261204.csv (csv), support_bundle_manifest.txt (txt)
From: procurement@bellassembly.com
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s impacting Order API — invoice hold

Thanks Camila and Ben — appreciate the rapid response and the artifacts.

We confirm the observed window from our side (22:47–23:06 UTC) and accept the proposed postmortem time of Tue 2026-12-07 10:00 AM PT. Procurement will attend to validate the credit calculation and provide our audit team with the log bundle once uploaded to the secure share.

Please note: our contract requires that any credit be applied to the next billing cycle and accompanied by the SLA calculation showing the baseline SLO, observed availability, and the pro-rata computation. Our finance team has flagged invoice INV-1124 for hold against the November statement until we receive the formal credit calculation.

For the upload: please use the secure share link you referenced (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/BA-2026-logs) and set access for alex@bellassembly.com and procurement@bellassembly.com. We will not escalate further if we receive the manifest + raw bundle and the credit calculation within 5 business days.

Appreciate the transparency — looking forward to the postmortem.

Procurement Team
BellAssembly Inc.
procurement@bellassembly.com
